notes.title: Patch Update December 19 2019
notes.notes:
Patch Update December 19 2019
- Add Key binding for Sprint
- Lava will not instantly kill you on easy mode.

notes.title: Patch Update December 18 2019
notes.notes:
Patch Update December 18 2019
- Add Invert Mouse options
- Add Difficult Level options that you can choose between Easy , Normal and Hard
But the secret bosses will never appear on easy mode
- Cryztals are back, some of them are alive on Frozen Cavern.
